mapper.select: SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS pp.id AS place_id, pr.review_id, CASE WHEN pi.pet_type_cd = 'CAT' THEN '고양이' ELSE '강아지' END AS pet_type_nm, fn_codeNm(pi.pet_type_cd, pi.pet_kind_cd, false) AS pet_kind_nm, CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, birth_dt, CURRENT_DATE), '개월') AS birth_dt, CASE WHEN pi.sex = 0 THEN '암컷' ELSE '수컷' END AS sex_nm, pr.mb_id, pr.pet_id, pr.point, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pet_review_like_mapping WHERE review_id = pr.review_id) AS like_total_cnt, pr.tag_name, pr.visit_reason, pr.visit_content, (CASE WHEN prlm.rlm_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS like_fl, prlm.rlm_id, (CASE WHEN prsm.scrap_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scrap_fl, prsm.scrap_id, pr.point, pr.create_ymd FROM pet_review pr INNER JOIN pet_place pp ON pr.place_id = pp.id AND pr.del_fl = pp.del_fl INNER JOIN pet_info pi ON pr.mb_id = pi.mb_id AND pr.pet_id = pi.pet_id LEFT JOIN pet_review_like_mapping prlm ON pr.review_id = prlm.review_id AND prlm.mb_id = #{mbId} LEFT JOIN pet_review_scrap_mapping prsm ON pr.review_id = prsm.review_id AND prsm.mb_id = #{mbId} WHERE pi.del_fl = 0 AND pr.review_id = #{reviewId}

choose.when: UPDATE pet_review SET place_id = #{placeId}, mb_id = #{mbId}, pet_id = #{petId}, point = #{point}, tag_name = #{tagName}, visit_reason = #{visitReason}, visit_content = #{visitContent}, update_id = #{createOrUpdateId} WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
choose.otherwise: INSERT INTO pet_review ( place_id, mb_id, pet_id, point, tag_name, visit_reason, visit_content, create_id ) VALUES ( #{placeId}, #{mbId}, #{petId}, #{point}, #{tagName}, #{visitReason}, #{visitContent}, #{createOrUpdateId} )

mapper.select: SELECT pr.review_id, gbf.wr_id AS file_id, gbf.bf_source AS file_name, gbf.bf_fileurl AS file_url, gbf.bf_filesize AS file_size FROM pet_review pr LEFT JOIN pet_review_file_mapping prfm ON pr.review_id = prfm.review_id LEFT JOIN g5_board_file gbf ON gbf.bo_table = 'pet_review' AND gbf.wr_id = prfm.rfm_id WHERE pr.review_id = #{reviewId} ORDER BY pr.create_ymd DESC

SELECT pr.review_id, gbf.wr_id AS file_id, gbf.bf_fileurl AS file_url, gbf.bf_filesize AS file_size FROM pet_review pr INNER JOIN pet_review_file_mapping prfm ON pr.review_id = prfm.review_id INNER JOIN g5_board_file gbf ON gbf.bo_table = 'pet_review' AND gbf.wr_id = prfm.rfm_id WHERE pr.place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY pr.create_ymd DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT rfm_id FROM pet_review_file_mapping WHERE review_id = #{reviewId};
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pet_review_file_mapping WHERE review_id = #{reviewId};

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS pr.place_id, pp.name AS place_name, pr.review_id, CASE WHEN pi.pet_type_cd = 'CAT' THEN '고양이' ELSE '강아지' END AS pet_type_nm, fn_codeNm(pi.pet_type_cd, pi.pet_kind_cd, true) AS pet_kind_nm, CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, birth_dt, CURRENT_DATE), '개월') AS birth_dt, CASE WHEN pi.sex = 0 THEN '암컷' ELSE '수컷' END AS sex_nm, pr.mb_id, pr.pet_id, pr.point, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pet_review_like_mapping WHERE review_id = pr.review_id) AS like_total_cnt, pr.tag_name, pr.visit_reason, pr.visit_content, IFNULL((SELECT bf_fileurl FROM pet_review_file_mapping prfm INNER JOIN g5_board_file gbf ON gbf.bo_table = 'pet_review' AND prfm.rfm_id = gbf.wr_id WHERE prfm.review_id = pr.review_id ORDER BY prfm.create_ymd LIMIT 1), NULL) AS file_url, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pet_review_file_mapping WHERE review_id = pr.review_id AND mb_id = pr.mb_id) AS review_file_count, (CASE WHEN prlm.rlm_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS like_fl, prlm.rlm_id, (CASE WHEN prsm.scrap_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scrap_fl, prsm.scrap_id, pr.point, pr.create_ymd FROM pet_review_scrap_mapping prsm INNER JOIN pet_review pr ON prsm.review_id = pr.review_id INNER JOIN pet_info pi ON pr.pet_id = pi.pet_id INNER JOIN pet_place pp ON pr.place_id = pp.id LEFT JOIN pet_review_like_mapping prlm ON pr.review_id = prlm.review_id AND pr.mb_id = prlm.mb_id WHERE pi.del_fl = 0 AND prsm.mb_id = #{mbId} ORDER BY prsm.create_ymd DESC LIMIT #{pageNo}, #{pageSize};
